th.style: background:#f1f3f5; border-bottom:1.5px solid #333333; padding:10px 14px; font-size:15px; font-weight:700; color:#111827; text-align:left;

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

td.b: UC-04: Propose Changes via Shared Workbench

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;
width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1. Application has at least one deployed version.
2. Collaborator possesses editor or commenter role via shared project link.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
1. Collaborator opens shared Workbench displaying live iframe preview alongside code controls.
2. Collaborator describes desired change in natural language or makes direct edits to draft.
3. System synthesizes code modification and renders interactive capability and code diff.
4. Collaborator reviews proposed diff and commits changes to session draft.
5. Collaborator selects 'Publish as new version', submitting draft to UC-02 pipeline.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
Success: Candidate version registered for review; stable live version continues serving unaffected.
Failure: Draft remains unchanged and conflict diagnostics are displayed to user.

td.style: width:220px; background:#f8f9fa; font-weight:600; color:#1f2937; padding:9px 12px; border-right:1px solid #dee2e6; border-bottom:1px solid #dee2e6; vertical-align:top;

tr.td:
2a. Collaborator submits comment only: Feedback attached to draft without altering code.
3a. AI generated change causes parse conflict: Conflict highlighted; collaborator prompted to refine.
